simple.summary: צְחֹק (tsᵉchôq) means laughter (in pleasure or derision) First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 32.

definitions.full: H6712. tsechoq צְחֹק noun [masculine] laughter ; — א לִי עָשָׂה ׳צְחֹק Gen 21:6 (E) laughter hath God caused for me; = laughing-stock , לְצ ׳תִּהְיֶה וּלְלַעַג Ezek 23:32 (strike out ᵐ5 B Hi Co Berthol Siegf Krae; not Toy).
